style.prompt: An 8-second widescreen 16:9 cheerful cartoon animation. A cute little orange robot with rounded shapes and expressive eyes gently waters a small green plant in a terracotta pot using a tiny watering can. Clear continuous action: the robot tips the can, a gentle stream of water falls into the soil, the leaves perk up, and the robot happily admires the plant. Warm pastel background, clean colorful cartoon illustration, soft lighting, charming wholesome mood. Locked-off medium-wide camera, robot and entire pot fully visible. At the very top center display the exact text 'Small steps' in large crisp dark friendly lettering. This title is present from the first frame to the last, stationary and unchanged, with generous margins, no other text. Keep the title area clear of the action throughout. Silent video, no music, no speech, no sound.
